log_text.description: Raw multi-line log text from Zigbee2MQTT (`zigbee-herdsman`), Home Assistant ZHA (`zigpy`/`bellows`/`zigpy-znp`), or OpenThread (`otbr-agent`). Inputs exceeding 2 MB (`MAX_LOG_BYTES`) or 25,000 lines (`MAX_LOG_LINES`) are deterministically windowed to head + tail slices with `truncated=true`. Empty or whitespace-only input returns `status='empty_input'`.

device_count.description: Total Zigbee nodes joined to the mesh network (mains-powered routers + battery-powered sleepy end devices, excluding the coordinator itself). Must be an integer >= 0 and >= `sleepy_zed_count`.

sleepy_zed_count.description: Number of battery-powered / RX-off-when-idle Zigbee End Devices (ZEDs) directly parented to the coordinator that occupy hardware `SrcMatch` indirect-queue slots. Must satisfy `0 <= sleepy_zed_count <= device_count`.

chip_family.description: Coordinator SoC family or SMLIGHT model identifier (case-insensitive). tool_signatures.name: decode_silicon_register
tool_signatures.description: Decode a hexadecimal MCU register or radio-core command status word into bitfields.

chip.description: Target MCU family, SoC part number, SMLIGHT coordinator SKU, or ARM Cortex-M core token (case-insensitive). Accepted TI SimpleLink F2 tokens: `'F2'`, `'CC2652P'`, `'CC2652P7'`, `'CC1352P7'`, `'CC2674P10'`, `'P7'`, `'P10'`, `'SLZB-06'`, `'SLZB-06U'`, `'SLZB-06P7'`, `'SLZB-06P7U'`, `'SLZB-06P7v1'`, `'SLZB-07P7'`, `'SLZB-06P10'`, `'SLZB-07P10'`. Accepted Silicon Labs EFR32 tokens: `'EFR32'`, `'EFR32MG21'`, `'EFR32MG24'`, `'MG21'`, `'MG24'`, `'SILABS'`, `'EMBER'`, `'SLZB-06M'`, `'SLZB-06Mg24'`. Accepted universal ARM SCB fault tokens: `'ARM'`, `'CORTEX-M'`, `'CORTEX-M4'`, `'CORTEX-M33'`.

register_or_addr.description: Register symbol, radio command name, or MMIO hex address supported for `chip` (case-insensitive). TI SimpleLink F2 values: `'CMD_IEEE_RX'`, `'CMD_IEEE_CSMA'`, `'RFC_DBELL'` (`'0x40041014'`), `'SRCMATCH'` (`'RFC_RAM'`, `'0x21000000'`), `'VIMS'` (`'0x40034000'`), `'PRCM'` (`'0x400821D4'`, `'0x580821D4'`, `'0x480821D4'`), `'UART0_FR'` (`'0x40001018'`), `'UART0_RSR'` (`'UART0_ECR'`, `'0x40001004'`), `'UART0_CTL'` (`'0x40001030'`), `'IOCFG'` (`'IOCFG0'`..`'IOCFG47'`, `'0x40081000'`..`'0x400810BC'`), `'AON_PMCTL_RESETCTL'` (`'RESETCTL'`, `'0x40090028'`, `'0x58090028'`, `'0x48090028'`). Silicon Labs EFR32 values: `'EUSART0_IF'` (`'0x5B01004C'`, `'0x4B01004C'`), `'USART0_IF'` (`'0x50058048'` / `'0x40058048'` on MG21, `'0x5005C048'` / `'0x4005C048'` on MG24), `'USART0_STATUS'` (`'0x50058018'` / `'0x40058018'` on MG21, `'0x5005C018'` / `'0x4005C018'` on MG24), `'EMU_RSTCAUSE'` (`'RSTCAUSE'`, `'0x50004094'`, `'0x40004094'`). Universal ARM Cortex-M4/M33 values (accepted on F2, EFR32, or `'ARM'`/`'CORTEX-M'`): `'SCB_CFSR'` (`'CFSR'`, `'0xE000ED28'`), `'SCB_HFSR'` (`'HFSR'`, `'0xE000ED2C'`).

hex_value.description: Observed 16-bit or 32-bit register or radio command status value as a hexadecimal string (with or without `'0x'` prefix, e.g. `'0x0807'`, `'0x2401'`, `'0x00000028'`, `'0x00008200'`, `'0x40000000'`).
